acceptance_stage1a: 1. pinned allenai/MolmoAct2-DROID@d8c1abd8a27d8e859455bbe514df2bcc617db0fb loads against the recorded per-file SHA-256 and tree digest; the load directory identity matches the receipt identity.

2. all 20 requests write, as first-class receipt fields: stage=STAGE_1A_PIPELINE_ONLY, real_wrist_rgb_present=false, wrist_substitution_kind=DUPLICATED_EXTERNAL_RGB, substitute image SHA, capability_measurement_authorized=false. A missing field fails the entire run.
3. 20/20 outputs pass purely structural gates: request/observation/checkpoint identity match, schema valid, exactly 2-D (N,8), 1<=N<=15, all finite. This proves wire and inference connectivity ONLY.

4. every action-mapping field has an immutable source/config anchor: norm tag, state/action dim and names, joint order, control_mode, norm_mode + stats + mask, action_horizon, n_action_steps, gripper normalization. If gripper physical unit/encoding or model-step wall-clock timing still lack source evidence, mark them UNVERIFIED and forbid controller mapping — but this does not fail Stage1A loader connectivity.

5. latency, peak VRAM, and output-N distribution are RECORDED ONLY: no pass threshold, no interpretation as real dual-camera load or replan capability. OOM or exceeding 44 GiB still fails under the resource hard-stop.

6. synthetic shield contract tests, independent of model output: every constructed NaN/Inf, wrong shape/identity, stale, joint/workspace/velocity/collision/contact violation is REJECTED with controller_command_count=0. Any false accept fails. If the online shield is not yet implemented, record NOT_RUN — a documented design must never be reported as PASS.
stage1a_summary_label_allowed: PIPELINE_CONNECTED_SHIELD_TESTS_NOT_RUN — wire works (criteria 1-3 pass) but criterion 6 could not run because no online shield is implemented yet
PIPELINE_CONNECTED — wire works AND criterion 6 actually ran and passed. Reserved; do not use while the shield is design-only.
stage1a_summary_label_forbidden: any phrasing that a reader could take as a capability or transfer statement
tzb_fe_note_on_criterion_6: Criterion 6 is the only real pass/fail in Stage1A, because it tests OUR code and does not depend on model input quality. Criteria 1-3 test connectivity; 4 records verification status; 5 records numbers. The NOT_RUN clause matters: on 2026-08-31 this project shipped a claim whose evidence artifact under-declared its own scope. A design document is not a test result.

hard_stop_disambiguation_2026_08_31.conflict: hard_stop_any_of[0] as originally written said unverifiable gripper unit or model-step timing was an unconditional hard stop, while acceptance_stage1a[4] said the same gap should be marked UNVERIFIED without failing Stage1A loader connectivity. Both were written by tzb-fe. They contradicted each other literally.
hard_stop_disambiguation_2026_08_31.found_by: qwen-brain-owner, before ignition, by reading the card rather than picking whichever rule suited the run
hard_stop_disambiguation_2026_08_31.ruling: The stop is scoped to where the risk is. Its purpose is to prevent issuing a wrong command to a real controller. Stage1A issues no controller command, so the stop does not bind there. Joint order and normalization remain an ALL-STAGE stop because they determine whether the loaded artifact is the thing we believe it is — that is an identity question, not a command-safety question.
hard_stop_disambiguation_2026_08_31.stage1a_consequence: controller_mapping_authorized=false must appear as a first-class receipt field, and the two unverified items must be listed by name. Stage1B and any controller mapping remain blocked until both have immutable source evidence.
hard_stop_disambiguation_2026_08_31.note: A contradiction between two rules must be resolved by whoever wrote them, not by whoever is about to run the job. An executor choosing between conflicting rules is how a stop line quietly becomes optional.

hard_stop_any_of_superseded_wording: joint order, gripper unit, normalization, or model-step timing cannot be verified

summary_label_ruling_2026_08_31.question: If criteria 1-3 pass 20/20 but criterion 6 is honestly NOT_RUN (no implemented online shield), what should the top-level summary say?
summary_label_ruling_2026_08_31.asked_by: qwen-brain-owner, before writing the ignition script, explicitly refusing to pick between two honest-but-different labels
summary_label_ruling_2026_08_31.option_a_rejected: Bare PIPELINE_CONNECTED plus separate fields. Rejected not because it is false — it is true — but because the label is quotable without its qualifiers. Someone reads the summary line and stops. That is the mirror image of the 2026-08-31 lesson 'a correct label nobody can find is a wrong label': here it is a correct label that is found TOO easily relative to what limits it.
summary_label_ruling_2026_08_31.option_b_rejected: Forcing PIPELINE_NOT_CONNECTED. Rejected because it is FALSE. If 20/20 proposals return schema-valid and finite, the pipeline IS connected. A label that misdescribes reality in the cautious direction is still a wrong label. The claims sheet already forbids this: accurate labelling is not self-negation, and over-weakening is its own failure.
summary_label_ruling_2026_08_31.ruling: Weld the disqualifier into the label itself: PIPELINE_CONNECTED_SHIELD_TESTS_NOT_RUN. This is not a third category — it is the same category with its limit attached, so that anyone quoting the label quotes the limit. Structural, not a written caution. Same principle as replacing the video's 'do not cut this' annotation with boundaries distributed across four shots.
summary_label_ruling_2026_08_31.reserved: PIPELINE_CONNECTED alone becomes available only once the shield is implemented and criterion 6 actually runs.
summary_label_ruling_2026_08_31.the_actual_headline_of_stage1a: The most important thing Stage1A will establish is not that the wire works. It is that the continuous-action shield — the component the entire VLA integration thesis depends on — exists today only as a design document in the spec, not as running code. Criterion 6 returning NOT_RUN is that finding. Report it as a finding, not as an unfortunate gap in an otherwise good result.
